gaps.name: constraint-engine-production-bridge
gaps.summary: Runtime exposes a deterministic preflight hook, but the production NODE-14 Constraint Engine adapter and NODE-39 validator integration are not wired in this node.

gaps.name: artifact-version-persistence-adapter
gaps.summary: Runtime returns immutable candidate snapshots and semantic diffs; durable NODE-15 Artifact/Version persistence and optimistic commit orchestration remain an integration boundary.

gaps.name: downstream-direct-mutation-audit
gaps.summary: The canonical mutation API is frozen here, but every existing Canvas/Agent/Export call site must be migrated and audited in downstream implementation nodes before production can claim zero direct persisted-IR mutation.

gaps.name: spatial-index-adapter
gaps.summary: Semantic query and geometry helpers are implemented without persisting an index; high-performance RBush/custom spatial indexing belongs to the Canvas runtime adapter.

gaps.name: standard-hardware-performance-gate
gaps.summary: Reference benchmarks are recorded in this node, but pass/fail budgets must be calibrated against the NODE-08 standard benchmark machine before they become release gates.
